title: Neet rates higher in England’s smaller cities and towns than in biggest cities
summary_full: Initiatives to address youth employment crisis and offer training are being launched in towns such as TelfordSmaller cities and towns across England have higher rates of young people not in employment, education or training than the nine largest cities, analysis shows.The Centre for Cities, an independent thinktank dedicated to improving the economies of the UK, used 2021 census data to work out the rates across 41 cities and towns in England.
